name: Battery pack (4×AA, 2S LiPo, 9 V)
description: Battery for motors and robots: a voltage source with internal resistance, so it sags under load. POS (+) to the motor driver's 12V terminal or the Arduino VIN; NEG (−) to GND. Pick a preset; set voltage to model a drained pack.

pins.description: Negative terminal (black wire). Shares GND with everything.

props.label: Type

options.label: 2S LiPo (8.4 V full, 7.4 V nominal, 0.04 Ω)

props.description: Chemistry and cell count. Sets the open-circuit voltage, internal resistance and current limit.

props.label: Open-circuit voltage
props.description: 0 = the preset's fresh voltage. Set it to model a partly drained pack (e.g. 4×AA at 4.8 V) or a custom battery.

props.label: Internal resistance
props.description: 0 = the preset's value. Terminal voltage = voltage − current × this.

bindings.description: Terminal voltage under the present load.

mechanical.source: 4 x AA holder class; swap for the real pack

sourcing.generic: Battery holder 4 x AA (6 V) with leads, or the pack named in the project
